# CodexMeter 1.1.2
CodexMeter 1.1.2 fixes a menu bar layout regression that could hide the entire usage body and leave only the title and footer visible.
## Fixed
- Keeps the scrollable usage and limit body at a usable height whenever the menu bar popover opens or reopens. - Adds a macOS layout regression test that verifies the popover cannot shrink to the header-and-footer-only state. - Preserves all existing usage data and accounting behavior; the issue affected presentation only.
## Verification
- Complete Swift unit and integration suite - Native AppKit hosting-size regression test - Signed local Codex app-server limit integration - 10,000- and 100,000-event ingestion stress suite - Universal 2 architecture, bundle metadata, ad-hoc signature, archive, checksum, and Sparkle feed verification
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Fresh installations can use `brew install --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter`.
## First direct-download launch
The app is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. Download the DMG and `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the official release, verify the checksum, copy `CodexMeter.app` to Applications, and remove quarantine from this app only:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-1.1.2.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Do not remove quarantine when the checksum does not match the official manifest.
